name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Solutions Engineer & Technical Pre-Sales Specialist
summary: Technical pre-sales and solutions professional with 15+ years translating complex product capabilities into clear business value for B2B customers. Owns technical onboarding, API integrations, and CRM/workflow design directly with client teams, including C-suite stakeholders, and builds the kind of proof-of-concept tooling that lets a prospect see value fast, most recently a self-serve automation audit that enrolled 180+ businesses. Comfortable as the technical voice of the customer, coordinating across Sales, Product, and Engineering.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built segmented cold-outreach engines plus an automated prospect "audit" workflow, a self-serve proof-of-concept tool that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot — contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead-routing logic, with strict data-hygiene protocols.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for service-based businesses, primarily on GoHighLevel, automating lead enrichment, outreach, and appointment booking.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure, managing the pipeline and account records in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, coordinating campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, including for a client in aircraft buying, selling, and storage, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
